linker.selection_evidence: A 8/50 vs 7/50 and independent C 15/50 vs 14/50; combined +2/-0

formal_1000_result.interpretation: small positive descriptive gain consistent in both splits, but not statistically significant and not uniformly monotonic per trajectory

post_C_screening.only_candidate_reaching_confirmation: XHand nearest-surface 0.10 rad; A +1/-0, independent D +3/-3, rejected
post_C_screening.confirmation_E: frozen before later screens but intentionally unused because no A candidate passed the promotion rule

stop_reason: geometric alignment, bounded contact correction, normal/opposition/contact-region objectives, temporal execution, PD gains and replay speed have all been tested under a single-method paired protocol. Further meaningful improvement requires a new learned or physics-in-the-loop method rather than more local A-set tuning, so retargeting is frozen and effort moves to the advanced policy task.
selection_boundary: formal 1000 was used only to measure the already-selected Linker 3 mm method and collect policy traces; the observed +3 net result cannot be used to retune any of the three methods
